rca_inverse_correlation: Brief assumed Natural Gas would be bullish, but today Natural Gas fell by -2.24% instead, likely due to unforeseen market dynamics.
lessons: Ketika prediksi pagi untuk Natural Gas adalah bullish, tetapi harga Natural Gas justru turun, maka Natural Gas jatuh sebesar -2.24%.
Ketika tidak ada risiko utama yang ditandai di pagi hari, tetapi kejutan kebijakan BI mengenai penyebab tekanan Rupiah terungkap, maka Rupiah melemah sebesar +0.144% dan IHSG anjlok sebesar -3.78%.
Ketika IHSG diprediksi bearish, tetapi laporan demo besar-besaran yang mengepung ibu kota muncul, maka IHSG anjlok sebesar -3.78%.
summary: The morning brief accurately predicted a bearish IHSG and foreign distribution, but missed the bearish turn in Natural Gas and did not flag significant unexpected events such as a BI policy surprise, labor demonstrations, and geopolitical news.
